maintainer_note: Hand-maintained (frozen) table; do not regenerate. Seeded from the bibliography Crossref check (bibliography/DOI_MISMATCHES.md, release v2026.10). Add entries with a new id; bump the version.
description: Printed references that upstream matchers resolved to a DOI whose Crossref record describes a different work. Every ORCHID exporter that emits DOIs applies this table: in the matching context the DOI becomes null, doi_status = 'dropped_mismatch', doi_correction = <id>, and the printed citation is kept.

contexts.literature_cited_source: the literature paper record keyed by this DOI (literature/papers.json) and every value field that points to it (paper, origin.measured_in, conditions.paper, cited_sources[].doi/paper)
contexts.tdb_header: the link from this TDB file's header citation to the DOI (model.model_doi of values linked to the TDB, phase-diagrams original_source, phase-registry assessment references, bibliography TDB links); the DOI stays valid for its own paper elsewhere
contexts.handbook_source_line: the source line printed under the handbook diagram of this system (assessed-phase-assemblage citations / original_doi, ESPEI ZPF references, bibliography handbook links)

scopes.context_only: only the occurrence in the named context loses the DOI
scopes.everywhere: the DOI identifies no article; dropped in every context it appears in
